data.content: In which sites was Iomeprol found to be a risk driver in France in 2010?

args.query: List all sampling sites in France where the substance Iomeprol has an IS_DRIVER relationship in the year 2010. Return site name, site identifier, waterbody name (if available), administrative region (if available), and the specific timepoints (year-quarter) in 2010 when Iomeprol was a risk driver. Sort by site name and timepoint.

data.content:
No data was found for the following cypher: MATCH (s:Substance)-[r:IS_DRIVER]->(l:Site)
WHERE s.Name = 'Iomeprol' AND l.country = 'France' AND r.year = 2010
WITH l, r, toString(r.year) + '-Q' + toString(r.quarter) AS Timepoint, r.year AS Year, r.quarter AS Quarter
WITH DISTINCT l, Timepoint, Year, Quarter
RETURN
  l.name AS SiteName,
  l.name AS SiteIdentifier,
  l.water_body AS WaterBodyName,
  NULL AS AdministrativeRegion,
  Timepoint
ORDER BY SiteName ASC, Year ASC, Quarter ASC
